# dreamrouter_port_forward (Resource)

A port forwarding rule (Settings → Routing → Port Forwarding): connections from the internet to `port` on the router are forwarded to `forward_ip`. An enabled rule opens that port to the internet (or to `source`). The provider checks what the router doesn't: the address is on one of your LANs and not the router, ranges are ascending, the name is unique, and no other enabled rule forwards the same port.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# HTTPS on port 8443 from the internet to a server's port 443.
resource "dreamrouter_port_forward" "web" {
  name         = "web"
  port         = "8443"
  forward_ip   = "192.168.1.20"
  forward_port = "443"
  protocol     = "tcp"
}

# A game server's port range, only from one network, switched off for now.
resource "dreamrouter_port_forward" "games" {
  name       = "games"
  port       = "27000-27010" # ranges and lists are forwarded to the same ports
  forward_ip = "192.168.1.51"
  protocol   = "udp"
  source     = "203.0.113.0/24"
  enabled    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `forward_ip` (String) LAN address to forward to. It must be a host on one of the router's networks, not the router itself.
- `name` (String) Name of the rule, unique among port forwards (case-insensitive).
- `port` (String) Port on the router's internet side: a port ("8443"), an ascending range ("40010-40020") or a list ("80,443"), without spaces.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active. Defaults to true. A disabled rule opens nothing.
- `forward_port` (String) Port on `forward_ip`. Defaults to the same as `port`. Only a single port can be forwarded to a different one; a range or list is always forwarded to the same ports.
- `log` (Boolean) Whether to log connections that use the rule. Defaults to false.
- `protocol` (String) "tcp", "udp" or "tcp_udp" (both). Defaults to "tcp_udp".
- `source` (String) Who may connect: "any" (the default), an IPv4 address, or a network such as "203.0.113.0/24".
- `wan` (String) Which internet connection: "wan" (the default), or "wan2" or "both" on a router with two.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule's ID on the router.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a port forward by its name (or ID):
terraform import dreamrouter_port_forward.web web
```
